Source: Guaguan åntis i liluk na materiåt.
Reference: Iron was an expensive material a long time ago (lit. before).
LLM_Translation: The metal nail used to be expensive.

Source: Chetdan tanduki i mås ya-hu na chotda.
Reference: Tanduki banana is my favorite banana.
LLM_Translation: Plantain bananas are what I like to eat the most.

Source: Tåya’ sa’ på’gu ha’ yu’ ni måttu.
Reference: She doesn’t have [a chart] because it’s just now that I’ve come [to the hospital].
LLM_Translation: There’s no one else now but me who came.

Source: I lugat-måmi an ogga’an mampus å’asgun.
Reference: Our (excl.) place is always so foggy in the morning.
LLM_Translation: Our place this morning was very cold.
